name: Tommy Pigott
summary: Tommy Pigott is the State Department’s spokesperson, named by Rubio in April 2026 after Tammy Bruce moved to the U.S. mission to the U.N.; he had been principal deputy spokesperson since January 2025. Before that he was strategic communications director at the Republican National Committee and worked on communications for Trump’s 2024 campaign.
